sources.publisher: SAIA, n. o. (National Scholarship Programme of the Slovak Republic)
sources.note: Terms for foreign applicants: no restriction on field and no list of fields; selection takes the field background of each application into account
Applicant tips: no priority or excluded fields; applicants choose host institution and faculty from the offered options
About the programme: supports mobility of students, PhD students, teachers, researchers and artists; names no fields

subject_rule: The programme terms and tips for applicants name no eligible or excluded field and no priority fields: applicants propose their own study, research, teaching or artistic programme with the Slovak host, and selection takes "the field background of the applications" into account. No page says "any field" in so many words.
notes: No list of majors or fields exists on the official pages, so no levels or programmes are recorded. The stay is a mobility stay at a Slovak higher education or research institution (master's-level students, PhD students, university teachers, researchers, artists), not a degree programme.
any_subject is left unset because no official page states it.
not_stated: A list of eligible fields or study programmes; an explicit all-fields statement; priority fields.
fetch_problems: The programme site refused scripted downloads (403), so its pages were read through the page-reading tool only; the home, about, tips and foreign-applicant terms pages were read. The call news page for the summer semester 2026/27 returned 404.
